backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented UI theming features, affected files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files including sections, components, hooks, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind/OKLCH theme definitions setting root and dark-mode CSS variables for colors, borders, and layout tokens.
frontend/index.html: RTL Arabic HTML entry point defining root mount element and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component that gates entry with an intro splash and renders layout, nav, and main content.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper adding background imagery, footer, and the floating help bot panel.
frontend/src/components/DecoratedHeading: Section heading component with an icon, accent styling, and optional custom classes.
frontend/src/components/HelpBotPanel.tsx: Interactive floating help panel supporting search, suggested questions, and section scrolling.
frontend/src/components/IntroSplash.tsx: Introductory splash screen with hero image, title, and CTA button to enter the site.
frontend/src/components/ProsConsCard.tsx: Component displaying pros and cons in two styled panels with RTL-friendly layout and icons.
frontend/src/components/SimulatorPanel.t: React component rendering an energy simulator with adjustable inputs and calculated outputs. Uses energy type metadata and simulator models to update values interactively.
frontend/src/components/TopNav.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with scroll-to-section buttons and a mobile menu. Includes a logo button to reopen the intro screen.
frontend/src/components/VideosGallery.ts: Displays videos grouped by energy type with fallback handling for failed loads. Supports both embed URLs and direct video sources.
frontend/src/content/energyTypes.ts: Defines energy type metadata including IDs, names, icons, descriptions, pros, and cons. Exported list is used across the app for content and categorization.
frontend/src/content/helpBotQa.ar.ts: Arabic Q&A dataset for the help bot, covering energy, citizenship, and Algerian context. Entries include questions, answers, and optional section IDs.
frontend/src/content/reportSections.ts: Structured content for the report sections, including headings, paragraphs, and lists about energy, citizenship, and their relationship. Used to render detailed informational sections.
frontend/src/content/videos.ts: Defines a Video interface and exports a list of three local MP4 video entries without energy type IDs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the current identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHelpBotSearch.ts: Provides keyword‑based Arabic QA search with simple relevance scoring and suggested questions.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for React Query backend hooks with no current implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionIntroGate.t: Controls whether an intro screen is shown using sessionStorage persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables, dark mode, RTL layout, and themed section variants.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/sections/EnergyTypesSection: Interactive section letting users select an energy type and view details with pros and cons.
frontend/src/sections/MainContent.tsx: Composes all main page sections with themed variants including reports, simulators, and videos.
frontend/src/sections/ReportSection.tsx: Renders a report section with headings, paragraphs, and lists using dynamic content blocks.
Displays interactive energy simulators with a selector tied to available energy types.
frontend/src/sections/VideosSection.tsx: Shows an educational videos section with a heading, description, and video gallery component.
frontend/src/simulators/simulatorMath.ts: Provides calculation functions for each energy type, generating estimated outputs like energy, emissions, cost index, and reliability.
Defines simulator input models per energy type and returns the appropriate input configuration based on the selected type.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with extended colors, typography, animations, and plugins for styling the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s metadata, current state, architectural notes, existing features, and known issues.
